Lesson 2 · Reasons like / dislike

Vuốt ngang nếu sơ đồ rộng hơn màn hình

Không giải trí not entertaining
① Mở I don't like this · I can't stand … · It's not my cup of tea
because
Nhánh 1 · It's + adj
  • It's + not + interesting / entertaining / exciting / thrilling / relaxing
  • It's + boring / terrible / scary / difficult / stressful / noisy
Nhánh 2 · It makes me + adj

It makes me + bored / tired / stressed / exhausted · I have to + deal with the same tasks every day

  • not my cup of tea
  • can't stand
  • I can't bear
  • I have to do lots of homework
  • I have to memorise long lists of new words
  • I have to deal with difficult customers
  • I have to deal with the same tasks and the same clients every day
Không giáo dục not educational
① Mở I don't think … · To be honest, I don't enjoy …
because
Nhánh 1 · It's + not + adj
  • It's + not + educational / useful / practical
Nhánh 2 · doesn't + V

doesn't + V nguyên mẫu · It doesn't give me the chance to … · It doesn't help me learn skills such as …

  • It doesn't help me relax
  • It doesn't give me the chance to challenge myself
  • It doesn't help me learn skills such as problem-solving
  • It doesn't give me the opportunity to widen my horizons
  • It doesn't help me enrich my knowledge
  • It doesn't give me the chance to try anything new
Hại sức khỏe bad for health
① Mở No, definitely not because … · I avoid …
because
Nhánh 1 · not good / harmful
  • not good for your health
  • harmful / detrimental to your health
  • It's + unhealthy
Nhánh 2 · can lead to …

Consuming too much … can lead to …

  • diabetes
  • high blood pressure
  • stroke
  • heart attack
  • cancer
  • obesity
Reasons Dislike ↔ Like
Giải trí entertainment
① Mở I love this · I think … · I'm keen on …
because
Nhánh 1 · It's + adj
  • It's + relaxing / exciting / thrilling / entertaining / interesting …
Nhánh 2 · Starter + V

It helps me + V · It's a great way to + V · It gives me the chance to + V · I also get the opportunity to + V

  • reduce stress
  • relax / unwind
  • clear my head
  • recharge my batteries
  • express my inner feelings
  • escape from reality
  • escape from the hustle and bustle of the city
  • temporarily forget all the pressures from my work
  • temporarily forget all the pressures or worries from your daily life
  • being in nature
Giáo dục educational
① Mở I love this · I think it's useful · Yes, because …
because
Nhánh 1 · It's + adj
  • It's + educational / useful / practical
  • learn skills such as … ↔ learn how to + V
Nhánh 2 · Starter + V

It helps me + V · It gives me the chance to + V · I also get the opportunity to + V

  • meet different people
  • meet people from all walks of life
  • explore different parts of the world
  • explore different cultures and traditions
  • widen my horizons
  • enrich my knowledge
  • challenge myself / push myself to the limit
  • become more confident and independent
  • become a better version of myself
  • become a more well-rounded person
  • develop my imagination and creativity
  • learn how to deal with difficult situations more effectively
  • learn how to manage my money / budgets better
  • learn how to curb stress more effectively
  • learn how to work as a team / work effectively in a team environment
  • learn how to think more independently
Sức khỏe health
① Mở I love this · Yes, because it's a great way to …
because
Nhánh 1 · It's a great way to
  • It's a great way to + keep fit / stay healthy / keep in shape
  • It's + good for your health
Nhánh 2 · Cụm V

It helps me + V · It also helps me + V · Eating … can also prevent …

  • keep fit / stay healthy / keep in shape
  • improve my health
  • strengthen my muscles
  • burn excess calories
  • maintain a healthy weight
  • prevent various health problems such as high blood pressure
  • prevent stroke / heart attack / cancer

Trái = KHÔNG THÍCH · Phải = THÍCH.

It helps me + VIt's a great way to + VIt gives me the chance to + VI also get the opportunity to + V

NO: I don't like + V-ing because + S + Vbecause of + NP. can lead to …

because of + noun / NP · It gives me the chance to + V · It's a great way to + V · can lead to …

Chỉ dùng cụm Food / health — không ghép ý job/team vào câu Food

Grammar notes · Lesson 3

Do you like X?
  • Yes + lý do
    • Yes, definitely / absolutely
    • I like / love / enjoy + V-ing
    • I'm keen on …
    • I'm a big fan of …

    Lý do

    • This is because + S + V
    • because of + NP
    • → tip: FAVOURITE (prefer … rather than …)
  • No + lý do
    • No, definitely / absolutely not
    • No, not really
    • I don't enjoy + V-ing
    • I'm not keen on …
    • I'm not a big fan of …

    Lý do

    • This is because + S + V
    • because of + NP
    • → tip: HARDLY EVER (I hardly ever + V)

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • Mang tính giải trí (relax / unwind)
  • Mang tính giáo dục (enrich knowledge)

Ví dụ Food · Thích / Không thích

Mỗi câu hỏi có Thích / Không thích + dropdown. Bật Hiện IPA để thêm dòng phiên âm dưới mỗi câu trả lời. Chip = cấu trúc đặc biệt (vd. hardly ever).

Grammar notes · Lesson 5

What kind of X do you like most?
  • Loại gì?
    • I like … most.
    • I love all kinds of …, but if I had to choose one, it would have to be…
    • … I would go for…
    • … I would opt for…

    Soft choose (chọn 1)

    • would have to be
    • would go for
    • I would opt for
  • Lý do
    • This is because + S + V

Grammar notes · Lesson 6

Do you prefer X or Y?
  • Chọn một X hay Y
    • I prefer X
    • I prefer X to Y
    • I prefer X rather than Y

    Form

    • prefer + V-ing / NP
    • prefer + V-ing + to + V-ing
    • prefer to V rather than V
  • Lý do
    • because + ưu điểm của X
    • while + nhược điểm của Y
    • whereas + nhược điểm của Y

    Cách triển khai

    • X …, while / whereas Y …
    • Thêm 1 ví dụ cụ thể (Ví dụ) để chốt đoạn

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • It takes + time (+ for sb) + to V
  • love the feeling of + V-ing
  • have someone to + V
  • send sth to sb
  • function (v)

Grammar notes · Lesson 7

Is X popular in your country?
  • Có + lý do / chi tiết
    • Yes, it's very popular.
    • Yes, they are very popular in Vietnam.

    Số lượng lớn

    • the majority of…
    • most / many / a lot of
    • a large number / proportion / percentage of
    • 60–70%
    • account for + %
  • Không + lý do / chi tiết
    • No, it's not really popular.
    • No, not really.

    Số lượng nhỏ / tần suất thấp

    • not many / very few
    • a small number / proportion / percentage of
    • 20–30%
    • nobody / no one
    • hardly ever / rarely
  • Còn tùy + trường hợp
    • It depends.
    • It depends on…

    Cách chia (phụ thuộc câu hỏi)

    • age: young people ↔ older people
    • gender: men ↔ women
    • income: the rich ↔ the poor
    • place: the city ↔ the country
    • food type: fast food / home-cooked / street food…

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • account for + %
  • can see sb/sth + V-ing
  • can't stand sth

Thời điểm tốt nhất Best time + reason
① Mở … is the best / ideal / perfect time to …
because
Nhánh 1 · Khung câu (chọn 1)
  • … is the best time for/to …

  • This is because + S + V

Best time to do X? Thời điểm ↔ Còn tùy
Còn tùy It depends + case

Nhánh 1 · Cách chia (phụ thuộc câu hỏi)

Cách chia phụ thuộc vào câu hỏi

  • Sở thích: For me … However, some people…
  • Lịch trình: busy weekdays ↔ free weekends
  • Loại bữa: breakfast / lunch / dinner / street food
  • Mùa / thời tiết: dry season ↔ rainy season
Nhánh 2 · Cấu trúc slide (Food)
  • find + myself / themselves + adj
  • function (v) — brain / body
  • during this time ≈ from 8 to 11 am / 7 to 9 pm
  • the dramatic increase in + N / the number of + Ns
  • However, generally speaking… / as long as…
Nhánh 3 · Lexical Food (thêm)
  • starving hungry, calm the hunger pangs
  • candle-lit dinner, ready meal, plant-based diet
  • local dish, piping hot, flavourful

→ chọn 1 trục chia (tôi/người khác · lịch · loại bữa) + linker hay (However / generally speaking / the number of)

Trái = Thời điểm tốt nhất + lý do · Phải = Còn tùy + Lexical Food.

Grammar notes · Lesson 8

What is the best time to do X?
  • Thời điểm tốt nhất + lý do / chi tiết
    • … is the best time for/to …
    • … is the greatest / perfect / ideal time to …
    • … is my favourite time to …
    • We should/can do X + thời điểm

    Kéo dài câu

    • This is because + S + V
    • last (v) + thời gian (which lasts from…)
    • make it + adj (+ for sb) + to V
    • So sánh thời điểm khác (During the rainy season…)
  • Còn tùy + trường hợp
    • It depends.
    • It depends on…

    Cách chia (phụ thuộc câu hỏi)

    • For me … However, some people…
    • schedules / preferences
    • type of meal (breakfast / dinner / street food)
    • season / weather
    • However, generally speaking… / as long as…

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • find + myself + adj · during this time
  • function (v) · last (v) · make it + adj + to V
  • the dramatic increase in the number of…
  • hearty breakfast / comfort food / grab a bite

Lesson 12 · Is it easy/difficult to do X?

Vuốt ngang nếu sơ đồ rộng hơn màn hình

Dễ + lý do easy / simple · not really difficult
① Mở It's very/quite/really easy/simple to… · It's not really difficult…
because
Nhánh 1 · Mở (chọn 1)
  • It's very / quite / really easy / simple to…
  • It's not really difficult / hard / challenging to…
Nhánh 2 · Kéo dài (slide → Food)
  • You can + V / There are… nearby
  • However, …
  • fresh ingredients · light meal · home-cooked

→ Dễ + lý do + 1 collocation Food (+ However nếu cần)

Easy / Difficult? Dễ / Khó ↔ Ban đầu khó
Khó + lý do difficult / hard / challenging · hardest part
① Mở It's quite/very/really difficult… · the hardest part is…
because
Nhánh 1 · Mở (chọn 1)
  • It's quite / very / really difficult / hard / challenging…
  • It's not really easy / simple to…
  • I think the hardest part is…
Nhánh 2 · Thời gian (slide)
  • take + sb + time + to V
  • take + time + for sb/sth + to V
  • especially for…

→ Khó + especially / hardest part + take + time

Ban đầu khó → dễ hơn at first · after a while · not an exception
① Mở At first… but after a while, things begin to get a bit easier.
because
Nhánh 1 · Khung slide
  • It's always quite difficult at the beginning when you try something new
  • … is not an exception
  • Take … as an example
Nhánh 2 · Tiến trình
  • At first, …
  • But after a while, things begin to get a bit easier

→ khung mở + not an exception + Take… + At first / after a while

Trái = Dễ · Phải = Khó + Ban đầu khó → dễ hơn. Câu hỏi lọc pattern Cambridge Food.

Grammar notes · Lesson 12

Is it easy/difficult to do X?
  • Dễ + lý do / chi tiết
    • It's very/quite/really easy/simple to…
    • It's not really difficult/hard/challenging to…

    Kéo dài

    • You can + V / There are… nearby
    • However, … (đối chiếu nhẹ)
    • grab a quick bite · fresh ingredients · home-cooked
  • Khó + lý do / chi tiết
    • It's quite/very/really difficult/hard/challenging…
    • It's not really easy/simple to…
    • I think the hardest part is…

    Thời gian + nhấn mạnh

    • take + sb + time + to V
    • take + time + for sb/sth + to V
    • especially for…
  • Ban đầu khó → dễ hơn
    • It's always quite difficult at the beginning…
    • … is not an exception
    • Take … as an example

    Tiến trình

    • At first, …
    • But after a while, things begin to get a bit easier

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • easy ≈ simple · difficult ≈ hard / challenging
  • balanced diet · junk food · from scratch
  • hearty breakfast · slap-up meal · local dish

Lesson 14 · How often do you do X?

Vuốt ngang nếu sơ đồ rộng hơn màn hình

Mức độ thường xuyên always → never (5 bậc)
① Mở once a week · usually · hardly ever · once in a blue moon…
because
Rất thường xuyên
  • always · all the time · every day / almost every day
  • five days a week · very often · a lot
Thường / khá thường
  • usually · often · regularly · frequently
  • quite often · 2 or 3 times a week · once a week
Thỉnh thoảng → không bao giờ
  • sometimes · occasionally · every now and then
  • hardly ever · once in a blue moon · never

→ chọn 1–2 cụm tần suất (có thể đối chiếu)

How often? Tần suất ↔ Lý do
Lý do / chi tiết when · why · with whom · example
① Mở at the weekend · because · I also…
because
Nhánh 1 · Kéo dài
  • at the weekend when none of us have to work
  • I also + freq2 (đối chiếu)
  • home-cooked · balanced diet · grab a quick bite
Nhánh 2 · Grammar slide → Food
  • none of + group (+ plural V spoken)
  • too + adj + to V
  • interesting to V … than to V

→ tần suất + when/why + (I also…) + 1 grammar nếu khớp

Trái = mức độ thường xuyên (5 bậc) · Phải = lý do/chi tiết + none of / too…to. Câu hỏi lọc Cambridge Food.

Từ vựng chỉ mức độ thường xuyên · 5 bậc

Chọn 1 bậc rồi nói tần suất + lý do. Có thể đối chiếu 2 bậc (vd. often ↔ hardly ever).

1 Rất thường xuyên

Very often

  • Always
  • All the time
  • Every day / almost every day / every morning / all day
  • Five days a week / 28 days a month
  • very often / very frequently
  • a lot
2 Thường xuyên / khá thường xuyên

Often / Quite often

  • Usually / often / regularly / frequently
  • Quite often / quite regularly / quite frequently
  • 2 or 3 times a week
3 Thỉnh thoảng

Sometimes

  • Sometimes / occasionally
  • Once or twice a week
  • Not often
  • Don't usually
  • Every 2 months
  • Every now and then
  • Once in a while
4 Hiếm khi / hầu như không

Rarely / Hardly ever

  • Rarely, seldom
  • Hardly ever
  • Almost never
  • Once in a blue moon
5 Không bao giờ

Never

  • never

Thang % · British Council (LearnEnglish Teens)

100% alwaysusually / normallyoftensometimesoccasionallyhardly ever0% never

Grammar notes · Lesson 14

How often do you do X?
  • Tần suất · chọn 1 trong 5 bậc
    • ① always · every day · five days a week · a lot
    • ② usually · often · quite often · 2 or 3 times a week
    • ③ sometimes · once or twice a week · every now and then
    • ④ hardly ever · once in a blue moon
    • ⑤ never

    Cách dùng

    • Xem bảng 5 bậc phía trên — đủ cụm slide
    • Có thể dùng 2 mức để đối chiếu (often ↔ hardly ever)
  • Lý do / chi tiết
    • at the weekend when…
    • because + home-cooked / balanced diet…
    • I also + freq2…

    Grammar slide → Food

    • none of + group (spoken: plural V)
    • too + adj + to V
    • interesting to V … than to V

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • once a week · usually · hardly ever
  • none of us have to work → dinner out
  • too tired to cook from scratch

~10 câu lọc pattern Cambridge Food (eat with family · eat out · cook · junk food · try new food · coffee · healthy · fresh food · breakfast · dinner with friends). Công thức: tần suất + lý do/chi tiết (+ đối chiếu I also). Grammar slide: none of · too + adj + to V. Lexical Food tái dùng.

Lesson 15 · How has X changed?

Vuốt ngang nếu sơ đồ rộng hơn màn hình

Thay đổi nhiều a lot / a great deal / significantly
① Mở It has changed a great deal in recent years…
because
Nhánh 1 · Mở mức độ
  • It has changed a lot / a great deal
  • It has changed quite a bit / significantly
  • in recent years · over the past few decades · since I was a child
Nhánh 2 · Past → Recently (Food)
  • Past Simple: In the past / A decade ago…
  • Present Perfect: But recently… have become / have started
  • have/has been + V3 (bị động)

→ mức độ + past (QKĐ) + recently (HTHT) + 1 lexical nâng điểm

How has X changed? Đổi nhiều ↔ Đổi ít
Thay đổi ít hasn't changed much · the only change
① Mở It hasn't changed much. The only change is that…
because
Nhánh 1 · Mở
  • It hasn't changed much
  • It has changed very slightly
  • The only change is that…
Nhánh 2 · Lexical nâng điểm (Food)
  • culinary traditions · dietary habits
  • a shift towards… · health-conscious
  • an increasing number of · have become more popular
  • processed foods · organically grown produce · nutritional value

→ ít đổi + 1 điểm only change + lexical cụm

Trái = đổi nhiều · Phải = đổi ít + lexical nâng điểm. Past Simple ↔ Present Perfect. Câu hỏi lọc Cambridge Food.

Chọn 1–2 cụm band cao + cấu trúc slide (a lot / little + Past Simple ↔ Present Perfect). Đừng nhồi hết.

Change & trend

Grammar notes · Lesson 15

How has X changed?
  • Đổi nhiều + sự thay đổi
    • It has changed a lot / a great deal / significantly
    • in recent years · over the past few decades · since I was a child

    Past → Recently

    • Past Simple: In the past / A decade ago…
    • Present Perfect: But recently… have become / have started
    • Passive: have/has been + V3
  • Đổi ít + sự thay đổi
    • It hasn't changed much / very slightly
    • The only change is that…

    Lexical nâng điểm

    • a shift towards… · an increasing number of…
    • culinary traditions · dietary habits · health-conscious
    • processed foods · organically grown produce · nutritional value
    • as + adj + as (not as popular as…)

Cấu trúc hay dùng

  • changed a great deal · hasn't changed much
  • home-cooked → food delivery / ready meals
  • globalization of cuisine · family-run restaurants

Ví dụ Food · How has X changed?

~10 câu lọc Cambridge Food (eating habits · cooking · restaurants · street food · taste · healthy attitudes · traditional dishes · family meals · diet · technology). Nhánh đổi nhiều / đổi ít + Past Simple ↔ Present Perfect. Dùng lexical cụm nâng điểm ở panel phía trên.
